description: Machine-readable map from user-facing Rise of Industry concepts to the internal members that hold them, for a read-only observer. Human-readable rendering: DATA-MAP.md (generated from this file by research/tools/datamap/render_datamap.py).

schema_doc.categories[]: Ordered list of concept groups. Each has id, title, entries[].
schema_doc.entries[].id: Stable dotted identifier for the concept (use in code comments and tests).
schema_doc.entries[].assembly: Assembly containing the type. Default Assembly-CSharp.
schema_doc.entries[].namespace: Namespace of the type. Default ProjectAutomata. '-' for derived values.
schema_doc.entries[].access: Recommended read path, written as member paths and plain-language steps. Always executed on the Unity main thread.
schema_doc.entries[].member_kind: field | property | method | static | reflection | derived | unavailable
schema_doc.entries[].id_strategy: How to identify the entity the value belongs to (see id_strategies).
schema_doc.entries[].source: Subset of [STATIC, SAVE, RUNTIME, DERIVED] (see enums.source).
schema_doc.entries[].update_frequency: How often the underlying value changes in game.
schema_doc.entries[].avoid: Members that look like reads but must not be called, with the reason.
schema_doc.entries[].evidence: File:line references relative to research/_local/decompiled/Assembly-CSharp/ProjectAutomata/ unless prefixed; or other evidence.

confidence.CONFIRMED: Read directly in decompiled source, game files, or save bytes.
confidence.HIGH: Strongly implied; one link not directly observed (usually prefab/asset data).

source.STATIC: Game definition data (GameData assets, content mods). Constant for a game module.
source.SAVE: Persisted in the .sav file and restored on load.
source.RUNTIME: Only in live memory (recomputed or transient).
source.DERIVED: Computed deterministically by the observer or MCP server from other values.

read_safety.SAFE: Pure field/property read with no side effects. Main thread only (applies to everything).
read_safety.SAFE_REFLECTION: Pure read of a private/protected field via FieldInfo.GetValue. Main thread only. Version-coupled.
read_safety.CAUTION: Side-effect free but costly, allocating, pooled (ListPool) or returning a live collection that must be copied immediately.
read_safety.AVOID_USE_ALTERNATIVE: The obvious getter/method has a side effect (dictionary insert, RNG, cache mutation, GUID minting). Use the access path given instead.
read_safety.DERIVED: Not read from the game; computed from other entries.
read_safety.NOT_AVAILABLE: The game does not hold this data.

global_rules: Every read happens on the Unity main thread (game collections are unsynchronized; ManagerBehaviour<T>.instance, ListPool, Formula pools and GetComponent are main-thread-only).
Use Unity null checks (the overloaded bool conversion or comparison with null on UnityEngine.Object) on managers and game objects; destroyed objects remain referenced.
Never call setters, Set*/Add*/Remove*/Clear*/Toggle*/Increment*/Decrement*, Validate*, Unlock*, Research*, Purchase*/Sell*, or any view-model method.
Never call Utils.GetSafe-backed getters on game dictionaries; read the dictionary with TryGetValue.
Never call GuidMapper.GetGUIDForObject, MoneyManager.GetBalance/GetRawBalance/RegisterAgent, DevConsole.Console.ExecuteCommand, SavegameManager.CreateSavegame, GameData.editorInstance.
Copy live collections (List/HashSet/Queue/ReadOnlyList) into observer-owned buffers before yielding a frame.
Use Player.humanPlayer for 'the player', never Player.activeActor (UI/debug can switch it) and never call Player.SetActiveActor.

actor.stability: Persisted (ActorManager._uniqueActorId is saved; restored via constructor params). Stable across save/load.

building.confidence: CONFIRMED (persistence); HIGH (uniqueness for warehouse module buildings, see U6)
